profile.headline: Senior Test Automation Engineer & Architect | 19+ Years | P&C Insurance Domain | Java, C#, Playwright & Selenium Expert | BDD | CI/CD
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Test Automation Engineer with over 19 years of experience, specializing in building enterprise-grade frameworks from the ground up for the Insurance industry. I bridge the gap between QA and Development by architecting scalable BDD-driven solutions using Java (TestNG/Cucumber) and C#/.NET (SpecFlow/Reqnroll).

My career is defined by transforming manual processes into automated powerhouses, most notably, architecting 'STAR,' a corporate-standard framework supporting 65+ applications, and 'Robokey,' a Playwright-based 'Policy On Demand' provisioning tool. I am passionate about CI/CD integration, observability through Splunk, and mentoring teams to deliver high-quality engineering solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Enterprise Automation Strategy: Directed BVT, smoke, and regression testing across all Lines of Business using Selenium, Xray, and Splunk.

CI/CD & DevOps: Engineered Groovy scripts for robust pipelines and created real-time Splunk dashboards to accelerate defect triage.

Key Achievement (STAR): Solely architected a C#/.NET framework that scaled to support 15+ projects and 65+ applications, unifying Web, SAP, and Mainframe testing.

positions.title: Senior Test Automation Specialist
positions.description:
Framework Architecture: Designed, developed, and maintained 'STAR,' an enterprise-grade C#/.NET automation framework supporting 65+ applications. Engineered the solution to unify Web (Selenium), SAP, and Mainframe testing.

Tool Development: Engineered the A2X utility to successfully migrate legacy test assets from MicroFocus ALM to Xray. Developed Model Builder to auto-generate Entity Framework (EF) Model Classes for Windows Forms applications, significantly reducing manual coding time.

Quality & Release Management: Managed framework releases using XL Release and maintained strict code quality standards using SonarQube. Leveraged Splunk for reporting and Jira/Xray for test lifecycle management.

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Automation Development: Designed and built the "EaseTest" UFT framework and a QC Reconciliation tool, successfully streamlining test maintenance and eliminating manual import/export tasks.

Complex Systems Testing: Executed performance engineering for Duck Creek using LoadRunner (COPE VUsers) and managed functional automation for Wealth Management systems handling real-time quotes, news, and alerts.

Performance & Recognition: Consistently recognized for "Far Exceeding Expectations" by delivering robust technical solutions, mastering complex scripting challenges, and ensuring high-quality delivery across critical domain projects.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
ETL & Data Logic Validation: Validated complex operational data flows through Staging and ODS tables using Informatica and PL/SQL, while managing the "Best of Breed" logic to ensure optimal data selection from competing sources (Lipper, Morning Star, ActionsXchange).

Custom Tool Development: Designed and built multiple internal utilities to drive efficiency, including V-SHINE (centralized knowledge base), a Valuation File Tester for automated database verification, and an Information Labeling Tool for security compliance.

Quality Assurance & Recognition: Executed rigorous testing strategies, including "data tainting" for error handling verification and XML/flat file validation, consistently achieving the highest performance rating of "Far Exceeded Expectations" for delivery quality.

courses.name: The Dale Carnegie: Effective Communications and Human Relations

honors.title: The Summit Individual Award
honors.description:
I received "The Summit Individual Award" for design and development of COPE VUser Tool.
 
COPE VUser tool is an automated solution to perform COrrelation, Parameterization and Errorhandling of any recorded HP LoadRunner Script. It has been developed in MS Excel VBA.

honors.title: The Summit Individual Award
honors.description:
I received "The Summit Individual Award" for design and development of QC Reconciliation Tool.

QC Reconciliation tool is an automated solution to download test cases from Quality Center and upload test results with actual result and status.
